The convergence figure is committed under the declared project-absolute figure path, and the plan/evidence update records the measured limits, controls and un-deployed status. The implementation and 16 focused tests cover the amended done-when from both starts, the knee tolerance, memory cap, controller floor, demand hold, prefix-hit response, publication, counter reset and both handoff corrections.
